name: Open Graph Benchmark: ogbl-collab
description: A collaboration graph derived from the MAG (Microsoft Academic Graph), where nodes are authors and edges represent collaboration; the prediction task is to predict future author collaborations.
citation: Hu, W., Fey, M., Zitnik, M., et al. (2020). Open Graph Benchmark: Datasets for Machine Learning on Graphs. Advances in Neural Information Processing Systems 33, 22118–22133. https://arxiv.org/abs/2005.00687
